statement: The proportion of SUID cases involving mothers who received pre-pregnancy health checks increased from 2008 to 2019.
rationale: This study aims to compare trends in the proportion of SUID cases involving mothers who received pre-pregnancy health checks over time. The design is limited to comparing proportions within case series data and reference populations separately due to a lack of denominator data for incidence rates or risks.
prior_art: None in the inputs; no prior work has directly addressed trends in pre-pregnancy health checks and previous births related to SUID cases, making this study novel.
cannot_establish: The design cannot estimate incidence rates or risks due to a lack of denominator data for the population at risk. It can only compare proportions among SUID cases and reference populations separately.
